title: Original sin that darkened his understanding, weakened his will and left in him a strong inclination to evil
html_source:
From the Maynooth Catechism.

Q. What other particular effects follow from the sin of our first parents?

A. Our whole nature was corrupted by the sin of our first parents- it darkened our understanding, weakened our will, and left in us a strong inclination to evil.
